verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gumroad has public REST API documentation, but nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as a try-it console or playground. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and a markdown API doc all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec that could drive an interactive explorer. Static API docs are an adjacent capability and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
